prompt: Create a high-fidelity static desktop website mockup of ONLY the enquiry form section of Dapper Detailing Pros Contact Us page, landscape 1536x1024. This is a section below the already approved opening, not another hero or entire page. Attached reference is the approved opening: inherit its off-white background, bold geometric sans typography, restrained red accents, crisp rectangular controls and editorial spacing. Do NOT repeat its navigation, car photograph, giant opening headline or contact-information strip. No decorative eyebrow or numbered sections. The visitor's task is to ask a question about their vehicle. Include a complete readable empty form, visible persistent labels, name required, email required, phone optional, vehicle optional, service dropdown with default “Choose a service”, message required, a short “Required fields are marked *” note, and a red “Send enquiry” button. Vehicle hint “Year, make and model”. Message hint “Tell us what you have in mind.” A small privacy link and “Submitting an enquiry does not book an appointment.” below form. No invented response-time promise, no prefilled personal data, no marketing opt-in or policy checkbox. No extra page sections, maps, photographs or footer. Crisp readable realistic website UI, no device frame. Preserve substantial input heights and sufficient whitespace to actually complete the form. OPTION B: broad editorial form with purpose selection. Across the upper part, a left-aligned “What can we help with?” headline in bold black with “help” red, and short supporting copy beside it: “Choose a topic, then tell us a little about your vehicle.” Immediately below, a wide simple row of three selectable outlined rectangular controls “Choose a service”, “Request a quote”, “Something else”; first selected with charcoal fill and white text. These are enquiry-topic controls separate from the service dropdown. Below them the form spans the width as an editorial spread: left half grouped Name and Email, then Phone and Vehicle; right half Service dropdown then a generously tall Message field. Labels always above fields. Fine grey input outlines, restrained white fill, no decorative background panel, no cards. Bottom full-width thin rule and a calm action row: literal link text “Privacy Policy”, “Submitting an enquiry does not book an appointment.”, red Send enquiry button aligned right. Do not add any agreement language, warranties or consent claims. Clear blank editable fields, readable text. The composition should feel like a considered modern enquiry sheet, immediate and confident.
approval: User selected B for the Contact Us enquiry section. Topic-first composition approved; service remains optional and privacy is a simple link without agreement wording.
implementationNote: Service remains optional; remove generated required service marker in B.
